# Contextual wording fixtures

These synthetic examples exercise the construction boundaries fixed for issue
299: document ownership, abstract evaluations, extreme quality predicates, and
unrestricted reader claims. They preserve scope conditions, quoted wording,
opaque code, and independent prose blocks. The CLI fixture applies BOM and CRLF
and records exact source segments for Markdown, a Go comment, and a Go string.
The complete-page confirmation remains separate from these development tests.
